evidence.text: Deployed cluster changes to the three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in my name.

Watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners'.

On the platform on-call rota throughout and handled the production incidents on my shifts, including the partition leader storm of July 2024 and four consumer lag incidents, all recorded in the platform incident log.

Watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners'.
Tested each cluster change on the staging clusters under the documented load profile before production deployment, with the staging results attached to the change record.
evidence.notes: Staging testing with documented load profile.

evidence.text: Documented cluster limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change record's closure section and in the platform runbook.
